name: Chrono Pendulum "Projection"
descriptionTemplate: After playing a Command Card that is not "Strike" or "Defense," if the card is not a Derived Card, the corresponding Awakener gains 15 Aliemus, triggering up to 5 times per turn. On the first trigger of each turn, the played card will also be returned to hand.
